title: ERA(Emi's Random Adittions)
description: Just random stuff that I add to the game, currently with a elevator block and energy item and fluid cables that can go on the same block
body:
# EMI'S RANDOM ADDITiONS
  A mod created with the ideia in mind to add random content that people may find useful on their everyday minecraft playthrough
## FEATURES
 - **Elevator block** that can be facaded as any block(including modded) and teleports the player on top of it to other elevator blocks on the same x and z of it, they can also be color coded by right clicking with a dye making so the elevator block only terleports to the ones with the same color as them(black elevators can tp the player to any colored elevator
 - **Energy, Item and Fluid cables** that can go all inside the same block, and also be facaded, each direction can be configured to your liking with options of extracting, inserting, both, no connection, black and whitelist filters with 5 slots, roundrobin feature and channel configuration
## TO BE ADDED
 - **Sky block** (block with skybox shader) compatible with shaders _(hopefully adding)_
 - **Ice Rod** (inspired from the terraria item with the same name) _(most likely adding)_
 - **Coal Generator** (basic energy generation) _(already inside game via commands just needs some tweeks to be oficially adding)_
 - **Ender Clams** (a non piglin/combat required way to get ender pearls) _(most likely adding)_
